ns2:course.label: Special Topics in Design
ns2:course.description: Topics and subject matter to be published in course listings. Class materials fee may apply. See Class Schedule. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, may be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term. 1 to 3 undergraduate hours. 1 to 4 graduate hours. May be repeated as topics vary to a maximum of 9 undergraduate hours or 12 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing or consent of instructor.
